question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        lt.term_start,
        lt.term_end
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
term_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        state,
        CAST(term_start AS DATE) as term_start_date,
        term_end
    FROM first_terms
),
target_years AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 0 YEAR as target_date, 0 as year_offset FROM term_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 2 YEAR as target_date, 2 as year_offset FROM term_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 4 YEAR as target_date, 4 as year_offset FROM term_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 6 YEAR as target_date, 6 as year_offset FROM term_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 8 YEAR as target_date, 8 as year_offset FROM term_dates
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, term_start_date, term_end, term_start_date + INTERVAL 10 YEAR as target_date, 10 as year_offset FROM term_dates
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ty.id_bioguide,
        ty.gender,
        ty.state,
        ty.year_offset,
        CAST(ty.target_date AS DATE) as target_date,
        CASE WHEN CAST(ty.term_end AS DATE) >= CAST(ty.target_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM target_years ty
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        year_offset,
        CAST(SUM(retained) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
-- For each state and gender, count how many of the 6 time points have retention > 0
state_gender_positive_count AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN retention_rate > 0 THEN year_offset END) as positive_count
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    GROUP BY state, gender
)
SELECT state, gender, positive_count
FROM state_gender_positive_count
WHERE positive_count = 6
ORDER BY state, gender
